correctness.rationale: For the 27 labeled words the undirected suffix/prefix test plus the center gives exactly the stated balls. Nonempty and distinct signatures are equivalent to hitting every ball and every pairwise symmetric difference. Independent replay used this equivalence rather than the packaged fixed-size signature scan: remove duplicate and containing requirements, then branch disjointly on the first selected element of an unmet requirement. The invariant version uses the 18 reversal blocks (nine singletons and nine pairs), with their actual cardinalities as costs. At budgets 8/9 the unrestricted counts were 0/4366; at budgets 10/11 the invariant counts were 0/117. Each returned code was checked again by direct signatures. Applying all six letter permutations with/without reversal yielded 372 classes (1 of size 4, 15 of size 6, 356 of size 12) and 22 invariant-optimum classes (5 of size 3 and 17 of size 6). Both attaining witnesses and both full canonical mask sets matched the source. This certifies the specified finite graph and group, not any other graph, radius, or full automorphism group.
